inspiration.observed_pattern: INTERVAL returns the bracket index for a value against an ordered list of numeric boundaries.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored scalar regression with one decimal value between the first two thresholds. It isolates INTERVAL's numeric bracket result without CASE, table state, or multiple rows.

fixture_notes: The value 13.25 is greater than 7 and less than 14, so MariaDB returns bracket index 2.
determinism_notes: All numeric literals are fixed and the scalar projection has no environmental inputs.
